reviews.text: This eye cream is amazing for sensitive under-eye areas! It has a lightweight yet nourishing texture that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. It instantly quenches dryness, smooths fine dehydration lines, and creates a clean, prepped base under concealer. It doesn't cause any irritation or milia. Definitely a staple for everyday under-eye care!
reviews.zh: 呢款眼霜對敏感嘅眼周皮膚真係好正！質地輕盈但滋養，吸收快，唔會覺得油膩或者厚重。即時補充乾燥、撫平細細嘅脫水紋，喺遮瑕膏底下形成乾淨、預備好嘅底層。唔會引起任何刺激或者粟粒疹。絕對係日常眼周護理嘅必備產品！

reviews.text:
I took a look at the ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Eye Cream, and if you're looking for a solid, everyday under-eye moisturizer, this is definitely a great pick.
The Dokdo line from Round Lab is super popular in Korea mainly because of how gentle and hydrating it is. This cream uses deep sea water, which is packed with minerals to keep the skin barrier healthy, plus hyaluronic acid and peptides to plump up the skin and smooth out fine lines caused by dryness. It also has niacinamide to help brighten up the under-eye area over time.
reviews.zh:
我睇咗 ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Eye Cream，如果你想搵一款紮實、日常用嘅眼周保濕霜，呢款絕對係好選擇。
Round Lab 嘅 Dokdo 系列喺韓國好受歡迎，主要係因為佢好溫和、好補濕。呢款眼霜採用深層海水，當中富含礦物質，有助保持皮膚屏障健康，另外仲有透明質酸同多肽，幫助皮膚飽滿，並撫平因乾燥引起嘅細紋。佢亦都含有煙酰胺，隨住時間可以幫助眼周膚色提亮。

reviews.text: I think it's one of the gentlest eye creams I've ever tried, and it's also very hydrating. I love its texture. This eye cream has a texture somewhere between oily and creamy, but it deeply moisturizes while also absorbing well without leaving a greasy feeling. I've used it with retinols and haven't had any problems. I recommend it for all skin types.
reviews.zh: 我覺得係我試過最溫和嘅眼霜之一，而且補濕效果好好。我好鍾意佢嘅質地。呢款眼霜嘅質地介乎油性同奶霜之間，但補濕效果深入，同時吸收得好好，唔會留低油膩感。我同 retinol 一齊用過，冇出現任何問題。我推薦俾所有膚質。

reviews.text: I really like this eye cream! It has a lightweight, smooth texture and absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy feeling. It provides great hydration and leaves the skin around my eyes feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed. I’ve been using it regularly and have noticed that my under-eye area looks more moisturized and healthy. Overall, I’m very happy with this product and would definitely recommend it for everyday use. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款眼霜！質地輕盈、滑溜，吸收快，唔會有油膩感。補濕效果好好，令眼周皮膚感覺柔軟、順滑、清爽。我一直有定時使用，發現眼周睇落更加水潤、健康。整體嚟講，我非常滿意呢款產品，會強烈推薦俾日常使用。⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.text: The product's formula appears to be unique, and users have clearly reported significant improvements in skin condition. Its ingredients are rich and highly beneficial. It's suitable for combination, acne-prone, and sensitive skin. I hope there will be no complications or allergic reactions with continued use. The moisturizing components are also beneficial for the damaged skin barrier, as mentioned and as used.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品嘅配方睇落好獨特，用家都明顯報告皮膚狀況有顯著改善。成分豐富，好有益。適合混合、易長痘同敏感皮膚。我希望繼續使用唔會有任何併發症或者過敏反應。佢含嘅補濕成分對受損嘅皮膚屏障都有好處，正如所講同使用嘅效果一樣。

reviews.text: for me it was not so good, it was a bit itchy. but it had a nice smell.
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講唔係太好，有少少痕。但係佢有好聞嘅香味。

reviews.text: This eye cream is pure comfort in a tube. The texture is soft, lightweight, and absorbs beautifully without leaving any greasy residue. I use it day and night, and my under-eye area feels more hydrated, smooth, and calm. It layers well under makeup and never pills — a huge plus! I’ve noticed less puffiness in the mornings and a general improvement in skin texture. If you’re looking for a simple, reliable eye cream that actually works, this one is a hidden gem.
reviews.zh: 呢款眼霜用起嚟好似一罐裝嘅純粹舒適感。質地柔軟、輕盈，吸收好好，唔會留下任何油膩殘留。我日夜都用，我嘅眼周皮膚感覺更補濕、順滑、平靜。佢喺化妝底下疊用都好好，而且從來唔會搓泥——呢點好加分！我發覺早上浮腫少咗，皮膚質地整體亦有改善。如果你想搵一款簡單、可靠、真正有效嘅眼霜，呢款係一件隱藏寶物。

reviews.text:
ROUND LAB - 1025 Dokdo Eye Cream

This is one of my favorite eye creams—deeply hydrating and nourishing. I’m already on my second bottle, and I’ll definitely repurchase! It’s gentle yet provides deep hydration, revitalizing and rejuvenating the eye area. Round Lab is easily one of my top brands, with high-quality ingredients that are perfect for sensitive skin like mine.

suitable for sensitive skin

perfume free

cruelty free
reviews.zh:
ROUND LAB - 1025 Dokdo Eye Cream

呢款係我最鍾意嘅眼霜之一，深層補濕，有滋養效果。我已經用緊第二支，一定會再買！佢溫和，但提供深層補濕，令眼周位置煥發活力、更年輕。Round Lab 絕對係我最愛嘅品牌之一，佢嘅高質素成分好啱我呢啲敏感皮膚。

適合敏感皮膚
